title: Stop hook input — fields consumed by stop_suite_notify.py
description: Claude Code delivers a larger payload on stdin; this schema documents only the fields this hook reads. Unknown fields are ignored. The hook runs the full pytest suite in cwd and posts the result to Discord when DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL is set in the environment; unset, it prints the result to the transcript only. Notify-only by design: it always exits 0 and never blocks the stop.

cwd.description: Project directory the session is running in; the suite runs here.

x-exit-codes.0: always — suite result is reported via stdout and (optionally) Discord, never via exit code

x-environment.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL: Optional. Discord webhook receiving 'Continuum suite: PASS' / 'Continuum suite: FAIL — check before shipping'. Never commit this value.
